target_customer: Enterprise customer experience and insights teams analyzing survey and feedback text
problem: Companies collect large volumes of open-ended feedback but cannot cheaply find the themes driving satisfaction.

founders.name: Alyona Medelyan
founders.background_notes: YC page and Airtree note her NLP PhD; the company says the idea came in 2015 while she ran an NLP consultancy.

founders.name: Nathan Holmberg
founders.background_notes: Co-founder, described by Airtree as Alyona's husband with a deeply technical background.

technical_complexity.rationale: Discovering themes from free text with NLP at enterprise scale needs real NLP expertise but used established methods in 2017.

defensibility.rationale: Integration into reporting workflows adds some stickiness, but survey suites could add text analytics.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Clarabridge was later acquired by Qualtrics per a comparison page, and large suites market text analytics. Thematic remains independent per its footer and YC page.

market_need_then: Survey platforms collected open-ended comments that were read manually. Startup Daily 2017 lists customers including Vodafone, Air New Zealand and Stripe, showing early demand.

branding.domain_note: Uses getthematic.com, a prefix domain; USPTO word mark registered 2019-07 to Thematic Analysis Inc per a trademark aggregator.

identity.logo: Original logo designed in PowerPoint by the CEO and tweaked by a designer friend, per a press account

rebrands.why: Company said it was time for a change

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive-feeling name with a prefix domain, and no press about brand pull beyond its 2023 refresh.

outcome_analysis: Thematic graduated YC in Summer 2017 and raised a 1.22 million dollar seed in November 2017 led by Airtree. It grew into an enterprise product with named customers such as DoorDash and Woolworths and a refreshed brand in 2023. No later rounds were found, so funding after the seed is unknown rather than zero.
notes: Seed amount also reported as NZD 1.75M, same round in a different currency. Airtree's post confirms it led the seed without a date or amount. CEO title and VP Product title for Holmberg per YC page; Airtree and others call him CTO or co-founder. Competition search returned only current vendor comparison pages with no dated 2017 sources, so the list is empty. Founding year: company says launched in 2017 after a 2015 idea. Name origin not found.
